stories.title: WWE SummerSlam Night 1: Live results and analysis for CM Punk vs. Cody Rhodes
stories.summary: Sach Chandan breaks down all the action from the first night of SummerSlam in Minneapolis.

stories.title: 49ers' Pearsall to have season-ending surgery
stories.summary: San Francisco 49ers wide receiver Ricky Pearsall is expected to have surgery on the nagging PCL injury that dates back to last season and will be out for the year, general manager John Lynch told reporters.

stories.title: Pirates acquire Yankees' Doval to bolster bullpen
stories.summary: Seeking bullpen help in their quest to end an 11-year postseason drought, the Pirates have acquired reliever Camilo Doval in a trade with the Yankees, the teams announced Saturday.

stories.title: Sources: Ex-MLB official tabbed to head Big East
stories.summary: The Big East is expected to hire former MLB executive Tim Brosnan as the league's next commissioner, sources told ESPN.

stories.title: Titans' Levis: There aren't 32 QBs better than me
stories.summary: Tennessee Titans quarterback Will Levis, entering his fourth season, still believes he's "a dang good quarterback" in the NFL, he told reporters Saturday, as he continues to battle for the team's backup position behind former No. 1 pick Cam Ward.
